title: 将AI引入自主系统：从认知到集体智能
summary: 本文强调自主系统是AI发展的终极阶段，提出基于通用智能体架构的设计与评估框架，将行为视为围绕长期记忆组织的认知功能组合，探讨感知与结构化数据的连接、决策规划及多智能体协调，并指出智能体可信度包含认知维度，最后评估了自主多智能体系统愿景与现状的差距。
summary_en: This article highlights autonomous systems as the ultimate stage of AI development, presenting a comprehensive framework based on a generic agent architecture that characterizes behavior as cognitive functions organized around long-term memory. It addresses sensory-to-structured data linking, decision-making and planning, and multi-agent coordination, argues that agent trustworthiness includes a cognitive dimension, and critically assesses the gap between the aspirational vision of autonomous multi-agent systems and the current state of the art.
